description:
Purpose: Replace whole sections of the user's profile with what the user asked to change.
When: The user asks to add, fix or remove something in their profile, not on your own initiative.
Cost: About 1410 tokens for the profile that comes back.

summary.text: Backend engineer with ten years of distributed systems work.

sections.description: The profile sections to replace, each in the shape profile_get returns it.

certifications.description: Every certification entry the section keeps, each with its id when it already exists.

contacts.description: Email, phone and location, as the profile's contacts carry them.

educations.description: Every education entry the section keeps, each with its id when it already exists.

experiences.description: Every job entry the section keeps, each with the id it was read with when it already exists.

languages.description: Every language entry the section keeps, each with its id when it already exists.

projects.description: Every project entry the section keeps, each with its id when it already exists.

skills.description: The skill items, as the profile's skills carry them.

socialLinks.description: Every link entry the section keeps, each with its id when it already exists.

summary.description: The summary text and the about-me text, as the profile's summary carries them.

userInfo.description: Name and headline, as the profile's userInfo carries them.

name: profile_update

outputSchema.description: The profile after the sections were replaced.

profile.description: The profile document as searchnapply stores it after the writes.

title: Update my profile
